title.zh: 【贝森特：美国本周可能查扣约 10 亿美元与伊朗相关的加密货币】
title.en: 【贝森特：美国本周可能查扣约 10 亿美元与伊朗相关的加密货币】

current_state.zh: 美国可能本周查扣约 10 亿美元与伊朗相关的加密资产，同时将对伊政策升级为“绝对孤立”，涵盖金融制裁、海上封锁、航空限制和陆路通道切断；相关行动是否已正式实施尚不明确。
current_state.en: The US may seize about $1 billion in Iran-related crypto this week while escalating its Iran policy to 'absolute isolation' through sanctions, maritime blockade, aviation restrictions, and cutting land transit routes; implementation remains unconfirmed.

updates.title_en: 【贝森特：美国本周可能查扣约 10 亿美元与伊朗相关的加密货币】
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国财政部长贝森特表示，美国本周可能扣押约10亿美元与伊朗相关的加密货币，华盛顿正将其制裁行动升级为对伊朗的“绝对孤立”。
updates.what_changed_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent said the US may seize about $1 billion in Iran-related cryptocurrency this week as Washington escalates its sanctions campaign into 'absolute isolation' of Iran.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️贝森特：拟本周查扣约10亿美元加密资产，全面升级对伊朗孤立行动
updates.title_en: ⚡️贝森特：拟本周查扣约10亿美元加密资产，全面升级对伊朗孤立行动
updates.what_changed_zh: 贝森特进一步说明对伊朗政策从“极限施压”升级为“绝对孤立”，措施包括海上封锁、限制航空运输、切断陆路通道，并与阿联酋、阿曼、巴基斯坦、土耳其协调；他还称当局已掌握拟查扣加密资产的位置。
updates.what_changed_en: Bessent further detailed escalation from 'maximum pressure' to 'absolute isolation' against Iran, including maritime blockade, aviation restrictions, land transit cuts, and coordination with UAE, Oman, Pakistan, and Turkey; he also said authorities know the location of the crypto assets to be seized.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国可能本周查扣约 10 亿美元与伊朗相关的加密资产，同时将对伊政策升级为“绝对孤立”，涵盖金融制裁、海上封锁、航空限制和陆路通道切断；相关行动是否已正式实施尚不明确。
updates.current_state_en: The US may seize about $1 billion in Iran-related crypto this week while escalating its Iran policy to 'absolute isolation' through sanctions, maritime blockade, aviation restrictions, and cutting land transit routes; implementation remains unconfirmed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington may seize about $1 billion in crypto assets this week while escalating its Iran policy from 'maximum pressure' to 'absolute isolation' through sanctions, maritime blockade, aviation restrictions and cuts to land transit routes.
updates.detailed_summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Washington may seize about $1 billion in crypto assets this week while escalating its Iran policy from 'maximum pressure' to 'absolute isolation' through sanctions, maritime blockade, aviation restrictions and cuts to land transit routes.
